summary: Evaxion A/S furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing receipt of the 2026 International Prix Galien Award for its AI-Immunology platform as best digital health solution, presented at the American Museum of Natural History in New York. No transaction, ownership, capital, or governance event is disclosed; CEO Helen Tayton-Martin and Chief AI Officer Andreas Holm Mattsson accepted the award. The filing also incorporates the report by reference into existing Form S-8, F-3 and F-1 registration statements. This is routine corporate news, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisers, or regulatory clock apply.
